purpose: Close the last railway organization-scoping gap from the #4459 series: GET /railway/demurrage returned every organization's demurrage calculations (with their deals and amounts) and POST /railway/demurrage/calculate stored records bound to no organization. A demurrage record now belongs to the calculating session organization and is listed only to it; a calculation without an organization is refused. Wagon ownership is intentionally not required for calculation, because detention is usually computed by the consignee, not the wagon owner. Follows #5712 (merged as 4c4102d8: wagon status and GU-12 creation) and #5716 (merged as a5af1abc: fleet list, GU-12 list and submit); this manifest is reused for the branch's next step because p7-source-controlled-scope.mjs allows one manifest per branch.
requiredInvariants: The caller organization comes only from the authenticated session (CurrentUser.orgId), never from the request body, query or path.
A missing session organization yields an empty list or a refusal, never every organization's data.
A demurrage record carries the calculating organization and is listed only to that organization, including when filtered by dealId.
Still enforced from #5712: a foreign wagon is indistinguishable from a missing one, and a GU-12 request containing any foreign wagon is rejected as a whole.
Still enforced from #5716: GU-12 requests of another organization are neither listed nor submitted and are reported exactly like missing ones.
No role bypass: ADMIN is an organization membership role here, not platform staff.
No DTO, validation boundary, baseline, register, workflow, dependency or lockfile change.
acceptance: cd apps/api && npx jest src/modules/railway: 4 suites, 55 tests pass.

Mutations on the 7 new tests: dropping the list organization filter fails 4, dropping the calculation organization guard fails 1. The empty-organization list guard is defense in depth only (no record can carry an empty organization) and is not independently killable.
knownLimitations: dealId ownership (that a deal belongs to the caller) is not verified by the railway module; it needs the deals module and is a separate step.
RailwayService.listWagons() without an organization still returns the whole fleet at service level; the only HTTP caller passes the session organization or returns an empty list.
